title: Yay! You've got the job! So Now What? Your How to Guide to starting new roles

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了用时间换金钱以外的钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将走上“有抱负的心理学家播客”之路。

sentences.en: With Dr. Marianne Duran.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Duran 博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家播客”。

sentences.en: I hope you're finding the content really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些内容非常有用。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening and for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的收听，感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: It's so greatly appreciated.
sentences.zh: 我对此深表感激。

sentences.en: What we're going to talk to you about today is thinking about, So, I've got my first kind of relevant experience poSt.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要谈论的是，嗯，我得到了第一份相关的工作岗位。

sentences.en: And it might be that you have got like an assistant psychologist post or, you know, research assistant post or something else,
sentences.zh: 可能你得到了一份助理心理学家职位，或者，你知道，研究助理职位之类的，

sentences.en: which feels like, you know, the next step that you've been striving for.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像，你知道，你一直努力争取的下一步。

sentences.en: And then you're like, so now what?
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，那现在怎么办？

sentences.en: You know, what do I do now?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在该做什么？

sentences.en: Now I've got to where I wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 现在我已经达到了我想要的位置。

sentences.en: And if you're listening to this and you're thinking, well, this isn't anywhere near where I am right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在听这个，并且心想，嗯，这离我现在的处境还差得远呢。

sentences.en: You know, perhaps you're a psychology student or a psychology undergraduate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许你是一名心理学学生或心理学本科生。

sentences.en: And you're thinking, well, you know, I'll tune out because it's not for me.
sentences.zh: 你心想，好吧，你知道，我不听了，因为这不适合我。

sentences.en: I would say, listen still, because it can still be super useful to think about covering these bases before you get there.
sentences.zh: 我会说，还是听听吧，因为在达到那个目标之前考虑这些基础知识仍然超级有用。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think this is stuff that I would have wished that I knew before I got there.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为这些是我希望在达到那个目标之前就知道的事情。

sentences.en: So, I hope you will still find it really useful too.
sentences.zh: 所以，希望你仍然会觉得它非常有用。

sentences.en: And it's all part of the process, you know, it will be your time and it will come and good things will happen.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是过程的一部分，你知道，这会是你的时刻，它终会到来，好事会发生的。

sentences.en: But we have to kind of, you know, do the bits below to build our knowledge and our skills and our experience and to build our readiness for it, for that.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须，你知道，做下面这些点滴来建立我们的知识、技能和经验，并为之做好准备。

sentences.en: And our ability to be able to talk confidently about what we're doing and why.
sentences.zh: 以及我们能够自信地谈论我们在做什么以及为什么这样做。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I hope that you will find this really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，希望你会觉得这真的很有用。

sentences.en: So, maybe this new job or new post offer feels like a really exciting, you know, tangible step.
sentences.zh: 所以，也许这份新工作或新职位邀请感觉是一个非常令人兴奋的，你知道，切实的步骤。

sentences.en: And I remember when I was, I'd just done my GCSEs and I got my GCSE results.
sentences.zh: 我记得当我刚完成 GCSE 考试并拿到成绩时。

sentences.en: And I felt like, oh, okay, finally, I've got something that kind of helps me put my abilities and my confidence kind of under my belt a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我感觉，哦，好的，终于，我得到了一些能帮助我把能力和信心稍微稳固一点的东西。

sentences.en: You know, kind of proof that I know what I'm doing and I'm doing all right.
sentences.zh: 你知道，某种证明我知道自己在做什么，而且我做得还不错。

sentences.en: And for me, those GCSE results felt like the first kind of thing, you know, that proved that, that demonstrated that.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那些 GCSE 成绩感觉是第一种，你知道，证明了这一点，展示了这一点。

sentences.en: And, you know, my first assistant psychologist post felt similar, you know, it was a sign to myself and to the world and others outside.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我的第一份助理心理学家职位感觉也类似，你知道，这是给自己、给世界和外界的一个信号。

sentences.en: Oh, you know, she's, I'm, she's heading, you know, towards that goal.
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道，她，我，她正在，你知道，朝着那个目标前进。

sentences.en: And that's tangible proof that actually this isn't all futile.
sentences.zh: 那是切实的证据，证明这一切并非徒劳。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I hope you find that as a useful way of thinking about that because I certainly did.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，希望你觉得这是一种有用的思考方式，因为我确实是这样想的。

sentences.en: And I know I said either in the, I think it was the first episode of the podcast, you know, that people might say, oh, I don't get it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我之前在，我想是在播客的第一集里说过，你知道，人们可能会说，哦，我不明白。

sentences.en: You know, why don't you go off and do something different, like be, you know, a buyer for Argos or whatever it was I was doing at the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为什么你不去干点别的，比如做，你知道，Argos 的采购员或者我当时做的任何事。

sentences.en: They just didn't, they didn't get why this was so important to me.
sentences.zh: 他们就是不明白为什么这对我如此重要。

sentences.en: They didn't get why I was, you know, so upset that I couldn't find even any, you know, assistant psychologist posts to apply for.
sentences.zh: 他们不明白为什么我，你知道，因为找不到任何，你知道，可以申请的助理心理学家职位而如此难过。

sentences.en: Or, and when I did, you know, why I was so distressed when they were closing before I'd even got home from work to apply for them.
sentences.zh: 或者，当我找到时，你知道，为什么在还没下班回家申请之前它们就截止了，我为什么会那么痛苦。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you know, you're allowed to be on your own team, even if those around you don't get it.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你知道，即使周围的人不理解，你也允许站在自己这一边。

sentences.en: You always need to be on your own team.
sentences.zh: 你永远需要站在自己这一边。

sentences.en: And, you know, we do doubt ourselves as humans.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，作为人类，我们确实会怀疑自己。

sentences.en: It's part of our incredibly tricky brains.
sentences.zh: 这是我们极其复杂的大脑的一部分。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you know, you're allowed to have that self-belief and that self-importance about why you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你知道，你允许拥有那种自信，以及关于你为什么这样做的那种自我重要感。

sentences.en: And that hopefully with, you know, the requisite stripes that you earn along your path, you know, you'll get there.
sentences.zh: 希望随着，你知道，你在道路上赢得的必要勋章，你知道，你会到达那里的。

sentences.en: Good things will happen for you.
sentences.zh: 好事会发生在你身上。

sentences.en: But, yeah, be on your own team, even if those around you are giving you kind of disharmony.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，站在自己这一边，即使周围的人给你带来某种不和谐。

sentences.en: You know, they're not singing in unison with you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们没有和你齐声歌唱。

sentences.en: They might be singing a completely different tune.
sentences.zh: 他们可能在唱着完全不同的调子。

sentences.en: And that's okay.
sentences.zh: 那没关系。

sentences.en: You're allowed to sing your own tune.
sentences.zh: 你允许唱你自己的调子。

sentences.en: And when I think about, you know, my other jobs that I've had in the past, yeah, you know, they would have sustained me and fulfilled me for a time.
sentences.zh: 当我想到，你知道，我过去做过的其他工作，是的，你知道，它们本可以在一段时间内维持和满足我。

sentences.en: But really, you know, to quote Princess Poppy, they just weren't my jam.
sentences.zh: 但真的，你知道，引用 Poppy 公主的话，它们就是不对我的胃口。

sentences.en: You know, they didn't ignite and enliven me and they weren't, they weren't a bit of me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它们没有点燃和活跃我，它们不是，它们不是我的一部分。

sentences.en: And so it's okay to keep striving for the stuff that feels authentic, that feels like it is going to light you up.
sentences.zh: 所以，继续争取那些感觉真实、感觉会点亮你的东西是可以的。

sentences.en: Because even though I love my job, I love what I do, there are still some days where I'd rather, you know, just sit around and watch Netflix.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管我热爱我的工作，热爱我所做的事情，但仍然有些日子我宁愿，你知道，只是坐着看 Netflix。

sentences.en: But on the whole, you know, actually, I'm really excited.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，你知道，其实，我真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: When I wake up and I realize it's a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, I'm like, oh, yeah, I get to do my business today.
sentences.zh: 当我醒来意识到今天是周一、周二、周三、周四或周五时，我会想，哦，是的，我今天可以做我的事业了。

sentences.en: I get to do the stuff I love and I get to see clients, you know,
sentences.zh: 我可以做我热爱的事情，我可以见到客户，你知道，

sentences.en: and I've got quite a nice balance that Mondays and Fridays are days where I do just stuff for my business development or stuff in the background.
sentences.zh: 而且我有一个相当不错的平衡，周一和周五是我只做业务发展或后台工作的时间。

sentences.en: And sometimes I don't do anything at all.
sentences.zh: 有时我什么都不做。

sentences.en: You know, I went off recently to a Van Gogh exhibition on a Friday and had lunch, which was really nice.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我最近在一个周五去看了梵高展览并吃了午餐，这真的很棒。

sentences.en: Last week, I had my hair done on a Friday and today I speak to you on a Friday and I'm recording podcast episodes.
sentences.zh: 上周，我在周五做了头发，今天我在周五和你交谈，我正在录制播客剧集。

sentences.en: So I've managed to stack my week and organize it so that I've got a bit more breathing space on a Monday and a Friday.
sentences.zh: 所以我设法安排了我的周计划，让我在周一和周五有更多的喘息空间。

sentences.en: And, you know, you might be hearing that thinking, oh, it's OK for you.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你听到这些可能会想，哦，这对你来说当然可以。

sentences.en: You know, I can't do that in the service I'm working in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我工作的服务机构里我做不到。

sentences.en: And, you know, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我听到了。

sentences.en: I've been there.
sentences.zh: 我经历过。

sentences.en: I've been there for sure.
sentences.zh: 我肯定经历过。

sentences.en: I hope that, you know, your experiences along the way and, you know, everything that you're doing and everything you're hearing from me, hopefully,
sentences.zh: 我希望，你知道，你一路上的经历，以及，你知道，你正在做的一切和你从我这里听到的一切，希望，

sentences.en: helps you build confidence and a belief that you can build a career for yourself that feels really energizing and that feels really exciting and that allows you to be your authentic self.
sentences.zh: 能帮助你建立自信和信念，相信你可以为自己建立一份感觉非常充满活力、非常令人兴奋，并且让你能够做真实自己的职业。

sentences.en: So, you know, some of the early feedback I've had from this podcast and certainly someone I was speaking to earlier about a university presentation that I'm going to be doing,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我从这个播客收到的一些早期反馈，当然还有我早些时候谈到的关于我即将进行的一场大学演讲的那个人，

sentences.en: you know, she said, well, we've asked you to do it because we like how, you know, how OK you are with being yourself and how naturally you talk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她说，嗯，我们邀请你来做是因为我们喜欢你，你知道，你对做自己感到多么自在，以及你说话多么自然。

sentences.en: So I hope you find that to be the case, too, and that you can lean in to your own abilities to be authentic to yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你也能发现这一点，并且你可以依靠自己真实的能力来做你自己。

sentences.en: You're enough, you know, and what you've got to say and the way you think about the world is important and valid.
sentences.zh: 你已经足够好了，你知道，你所说的和你思考世界的方式是重要且有效的。

sentences.en: This is quite a long introduction to this, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这篇介绍有点长，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, but it's all relevant.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但这一切都是相关的。

sentences.en: You know, I've got to I've got to boost you out and send you out there into the world to do these really good things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我得，我得鼓励你，把你送到世界上去做这些真正好的事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, I know I've got a lot of strings to my bow currently, but I feel like, you know, everything I do and everything I've got is underpinned by my core foundations.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我知道我目前有很多手段，但我感觉，你知道，我所做的一切和我所拥有的一切都是由我的核心基础支撑的。

sentences.en: You know, my experiences as a qualified psychologist and within every session, you know, within every podcast episode, within every, you know, thing I write for the media.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我作为合格心理学家的经历，在每一次会谈中，你知道，在每一集播客中，在每一件，你知道，我为媒体写的东西中。

sentences.en: I carry with me each individual client session, each individual supervision session and each individual lecture.
sentences.zh: 我随身带着每一次单独的客户会谈、每一次单独的督导会谈和每一次单独的讲座。

sentences.en: I've been to, you know, because of the way that we build over time as clinicians.
sentences.zh: 我去过，你知道，因为我们作为临床医生随着时间推移而建立的方式。

sentences.en: I'm multi-layered, you know, and I'm, you know, I'm built of a lot of the words of others and the experience of others.
sentences.zh: 我是多层次的，你知道，而且我，你知道，我是由许多他人的话语和他人的经验构建而成的。

sentences.en: And I'm pretty fortunate that, you know, on the whole, I've been surrounded by people that really like me and get me and are on my team.
sentences.zh: 而且我很幸运，你知道，总的来说，我被那些真正喜欢我、理解我并站在我这一边的人所包围。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's important to tune in to the quality of the, you know, the voices you're hearing to think about whether actually what they're asking of you is reasonable,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，调频到你所听到的声音的质量，去思考他们对你的要求是否合理，这很重要，

sentences.en: what their opinions of you are, you know, are based on actual facts and not just their own, you know, beliefs and opinions.
sentences.zh: 他们对你的看法，你知道，是否基于事实，而不仅仅是他们自己的，你知道，信念和观点。

sentences.en: So, yeah, tune in to, tune in to what you're thinking about what you're doing and just listen to, you know, whether, whether the feedback you're getting, if it's not great,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，调频到，调频到你对自己在做什么的思考，只是听听，你知道，是否，你得到的反馈，如果它不是很好，

sentences.en: is feeling like it's coming from a place that's trying to help you be different or better, whether it's kind of constructive feedback.
sentences.zh: 感觉它是否来自一个试图帮助你变得不同或更好、是否是某种建设性反馈的地方。

sentences.en: So well done you, you've got this job, you've got this job that you've really, really been excited for.
sentences.zh: 所以做得好，你得到了这份工作，你得到了这份你一直非常、非常期待的工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, you've had the moment of seeing the job advert or hearing about it for the first time and you just, you know, you read it and you think, that's it, that's my job,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，你经历了看到招聘广告或第一次听说它的时刻，你只是，你知道，你读了它，然后想，就是它，那是我的工作，

sentences.en: that's happening, that's happening for me.
sentences.zh: 那正在发生，那正在为我发生。

sentences.en: And I got that when I applied for my first assistant post that I did get, believe me, I applied for a fair few that I didn't even get interviewed for.
sentences.zh: 当我申请我确实得到的第一份助理职位时，我就是这样，相信我，我申请了不少甚至连面试机会都没得到的职位。

sentences.en: So, but yeah, the one I got, you know, I saw, yeah, this is it, you know, I am ready for this, this is mine.
sentences.zh: 所以，但是是的，我得到的那份，你知道，我看到了，是的，就是这个，你知道，我准备好迎接这个了，这是我的。

sentences.en: And the same with my second assistant paid poSt.
sentences.zh: 我的第二份带薪助理职位也是如此。

sentences.en: I just saw it and I was like, that's mine, that is my job and I'm coming for it and nothing is stopping me.
sentences.zh: 我只是看到了它，我就想，那是我的，那是我的工作，我冲着它去了，没有什么能阻止我。

sentences.en: I'm just going to be relentless about it.
sentences.zh: 我只是要对此锲而不舍。

sentences.en: This is my job, whereas in contrast from my first qualified job, yeah, I just, I'm really excited about the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这是我的工作，而相比之下，对于我的第一份合格后的工作，是的，我只是，我真的对这个机会感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But there were so few jobs at the time that I don't know if I actually would have ended up working in CAMHS if it hadn't just been that they, you know, they offered me the job.
sentences.zh: 但当时的工作太少了，我不知道如果不是因为他们，你知道，他们给了我这份工作，我是否最终会去 CAMHS 工作。

sentences.en: But it ended up working out completely beautifully for my first four years of qualified.
sentences.zh: 但它最终在我合格后的前四年里运作得非常完美。

sentences.en: So, you know, you've got this job, you've got the job offer.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，你得到了这份工作，你得到了工作邀请。

sentences.en: Perhaps you're waiting out your notice at your old job and those can be slow and painful weeks.
sentences.zh: 也许你正在旧工作中等待通知期结束，那些可能是缓慢而痛苦的几周。

sentences.en: But, you know, maybe you're listening to this, you know, about to start your new job or maybe you're, you know, you haven't got a job at the moment.

sentences.zh: 后来我获得资格后，大家都喜欢“敏捷办公”，对吧？

sentences.en: And then when I was qualified, everyone loves agile working, right?
sentences.zh: 我甚至连把椅子都没有。

sentences.en: You know, I didn't even have a chair.
sentences.zh: 我当时真是太幸福了却不自知。

sentences.en: You know, I really didn't know I was born.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你发现自己有一个非常好的办公环境，有自己的椅子，那就庆祝一下吧，在领英上艾特我，庆祝你拥有自己的椅子。

sentences.en: So, if you find that you've got like a really good setup and you've, you know, got your own chair, celebrate that, you know, tag me in on LinkedIn, celebrate your own chair,
sentences.zh: 在上面贴个标签，写上你的名字，坐在上面转圈，举办你自己的办公椅奥林匹克运动会。

sentences.en: put a sign on it, you know, saying your name and your chair, spin around on it, do your own office chair Olympics, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，你拥有自己的椅子，你的人生成功了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you've got your own chair, you've made it in life.
sentences.zh: 所以，这肯定比我职业生涯中某些时候拥有的要好得多。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's certainly more than I've had across my career at times.
sentences.zh: 但希望无论环境如何，我们都能发挥出最佳水平。

sentences.en: But, you know, we are able to bring out a game regardless of our settings, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 不过，敏捷办公对我来说是个王牌。

sentences.en: But, yeah, agile working is an ace for me.
sentences.zh: 我记得在 Argos 总部工作时，

sentences.en: You know, I remember when I was working at Argos Head Office,
sentences.zh: 我的办公桌周围有那种小隔板，我还贴了旅行时的照片，以便在困难时期看看。

sentences.en: I kind of had those little baffle boards around my desk and I had pictures of when I'd been away travelling to be able to look on when times felt hard.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢有好看的东西可以看。

sentences.en: So, I like, you know, I like having nice things to look at.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢有意义、重要的照片。

sentences.en: I like having pictures that feel significant, that feel important.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为我在属于自己的空间里工作效率最高。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think I definitely operate best with my own space that's mine.
sentences.zh: 我不需要去消毒键盘。

sentences.en: I don't have to sanitise the keyboard, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是我能发挥最佳状态的地方。

sentences.en: So, that's where I will operate optimally for me.
sentences.zh: 但如果你目前正面临敏捷办公的挑战，我理解你。

sentences.en: But if you're currently having your own agile working challenges, then I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我得到第一份合格心理学家职位时，正值当时的经济衰退之后。

sentences.en: So, when I got my first qualified post, it had been off the back of the recession that was happening at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时的工作岗位非常非常少。

sentences.en: And there were very, very few jobs.
sentences.zh: 那时，临床培训的名额也在减少。

sentences.en: And at that time, places on clinical training were reducing.
sentences.zh: 不是在学期中途减少，那将是灾难性的。

sentences.en: Not mid-cohort or anything, that would be catastrophic.
sentences.zh: “你是最薄弱的一环，再见。”

sentences.en: You are the weakest link, goodbye.
sentences.zh: 情况并非如此。

sentences.en: It wasn't like that.
sentences.zh: 但突然间，我们这一届有15人，而我们下一届有17人。

sentences.en: But, you know, suddenly we were a cohort of 15 and then the year after us were 17.
sentences.zh: 再下一届，我想人数减少了。

sentences.en: And the year after that, I think, went down.
sentences.zh: 可能又是15人，或者更少。

sentences.en: It might have been 15 again or it might have been below that.
sentences.zh: 但我记得有一次他们只有10人的班级，这与15人的班级非常不同。

sentences.en: But I think at one point they had a cohort of 10, which is very different to a cohort of 15.
sentences.zh: 所以，时代在变。

sentences.en: So, yeah, the times, times they were changing at that time.
sentences.zh: 实际上，当我获得合格心理学家资格时，我没有工作可做。

sentences.en: So, actually, when I qualified as a qualified psychologist, I had no job to go to.
sentences.zh: 我参加了不少面试，但没有得到工作。

sentences.en: I'd been to a fair few interviews, but I had no job to go to.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己总是被那些已经有几年从业经验的人挤掉。

sentences.en: And actually, I found that I kept getting pipped to the post by people that had already been qualified for a few years.
sentences.zh: 作为一名刚获得资格的七级（Band 7）心理学家，我当时已经足够优秀了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was good enough at that time as a newly qualified Band 7.
sentences.zh: 但很难与那些可能从八级（8A）降级来做七级工作的人竞争。

sentences.en: But it's very hard to compete with somebody who, you know, might be stepping down from an 8A to come and do Band 7.
sentences.zh: 或者与任何有经验的合格心理学家竞争。

sentences.en: Or, you know, to compete with any qualified psychologist that had been doing it for a while.
sentences.zh: 因为我当然是刚从临床博士的船上下来。

sentences.en: Because I was, of course, fresh off my clinical doctorate boat.
sentences.zh: 所以，我发现自己总是失败，直到我终于得到了第一份合格的职位。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, that's, I just found that I kept losing out until I didn't, you know, until I got my first qualified poSt.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我有一点空闲时间。

sentences.en: And at that point, yeah, I had a little bit of downtime.
sentences.zh: 我在九月结束了学业。

sentences.en: So, I finished in September.
sentences.zh: 然后我休息了十月和十一月。

sentences.en: Then I had October off and November off.
sentences.zh: 我想在十一月的某个时候，我知道我快要开始工作了。

sentences.en: And I think at some point in November, I knew I was going to be starting.
sentences.zh: 所以，在十二月初，我开始了我的工作。

sentences.en: And so, at the beginning of December, I did start my job.
sentences.zh: 我有一点时间，吃了很多扁豆做的东西来省钱。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I had a little bit of time, you know, eating lots of things with lentils in to try and make the money go further.
sentences.zh: 并尽可能多地动用我的积蓄。

sentences.en: And drawing on my savings a bit as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的伴侣（现在是我丈夫）也不忍心看我流落街头。

sentences.en: And also, you know, my partner, who's now my husband, wasn't going to see me destitute and out on the street.
sentences.zh: 因为那意味着他也得流落街头。

sentences.en: Because that would have meant he was on the street as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，只能熬过去。

sentences.en: So, you know, just had to get through it.
sentences.zh: 因为我们都知道，临床博士学位是一段培训合同期。

sentences.en: Because, of course, what we know about, certainly about the clinical doctorate, is that it's a period of training contract.
sentences.zh: 只要你达到了那些里程碑，完成了你应该做的事情。

sentences.en: So long as you meet those milestones and you get there and, you know, you do what you're supposed to be doing.
sentences.zh: 那么，运气好的话，你就会成为一名合格的心理学家。

sentences.en: Then, with any luck, you will become a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何工作保障。

sentences.en: But there is no guarantee of a job.
sentences.zh: 当我在2011年获得资格时，这一点被大声且明确地告知了。

sentences.en: And that was absolutely allowed, you know, around loud and clear when I was qualifying in 2011.
sentences.zh: 所以会有起起落落。

sentences.en: So there will be an ebb and a flow.
sentences.zh: 有时工作会多一些，有时会少一些。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes there will be more jobs and sometimes there will be less.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，我在2011年底开始工作，及时赶上了圣诞节发工资，这总是很棒的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, happily, I was able to start work in the tail end of 2011 in time to get paid for Christmas, which is always really nice.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢工作之间的这段空档期，因为它让我能够反思、巩固，并让自己过渡到下一个阶段。

sentences.en: But what I like about this time off between jobs is that ability to reflect and to consolidate and to allow myself to transition to this next step, this next stage.
sentences.zh: 因为这些阶段都很重要，我喜欢有一点暂停，我们称之为“休息与消化”。

sentences.en: Because they are significant and, you know, I just like a little bit of pause and, you know, what we talk about is rest and digeSt.
sentences.zh: 因为这些阶段都很重要，我喜欢有一点暂停，我们称之为“休息与消化”。

sentences.en: You know, just, you know, just do a bit less, you know, breathe a bit more.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是，你知道，少做一点，你知道，多呼吸一下。

sentences.en: If that was now, I'd be probably going out for runs and stuff more.
sentences.zh: 如果是在现在，我可能会更多地去跑步之类的。

sentences.en: I think I was less fixated on any kind of exercise at the time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当时我对任何形式的锻炼都没有那么执着。

sentences.en: Probably doing Pilates and things like that.
sentences.zh: 可能就是做做普拉提之类的运动。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I would now I'm a mummy.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我现在当了妈妈，我会去做的。

sentences.en: I'm super good at using time off, you know, to its optimal ability.
sentences.zh: 我非常擅长利用休息时间，你知道，发挥它的最大价值。

sentences.en: So when I first started my first qualified job, I'll, you know, be forever grateful to my manager at the time because, you know, she was super excited that I joined the team,
sentences.zh: 所以当我开始第一份正式工作时，你知道，我会永远感激当时的经理，因为，你知道，她对我加入团队感到非常兴奋，

sentences.en: which is always lovely.
sentences.zh: 这总是很令人愉快。

sentences.en: But, you know, there weren't kid gloves and I thought I needed kid gloves.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，并没有什么特殊照顾，而我当时以为我需要这种照顾。

sentences.en: I thought I needed, you know, when you are newly qualified, you know, you can have to, like, work up to doing X, Y and Z.
sentences.zh: 我以为我需要，你知道，当你刚拿到资格时，你知道，你可能得慢慢来，才能去做这做那。

sentences.en: And, you know, there wasn't that, you know, it's like, well, you are a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，并没有那种过渡，你知道，就像是，好吧，你已经是合格的心理学家了。

sentences.en: You are the real deal.
sentences.zh: 你是货真价实的。

sentences.en: You know, you've earned your stripes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你已经证明了自己的能力。

sentences.en: Now go.
sentences.zh: 现在开始吧。

sentences.en: But it wasn't like my caseload built as a flood immediately.
sentences.zh: 但我的工作量并不是一下子就铺天盖地而来的。

sentences.en: That bit trickled in in a gradual, predictable way.
sentences.zh: 那部分工作是循序渐进、有预见性地慢慢增加的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, there wasn't that period of, you know, oh, you know, just see how you go.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，并没有那种，你知道，哦，你知道，先看看你表现如何的过渡期。

sentences.en: Get used to making decisions, you know, get used to doing that and being part of the team.
sentences.zh: 习惯于做决定，你知道，习惯于做那些事并成为团队的一员。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes I was just sent to kind of, you know, be in a meeting as the psychologist in the team.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时我只是被派去，你知道，以团队心理学家的身份参加会议。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: It wasn't like I was shadowing a proper psychologist who knew what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我在跟随一位真正知道自己在做什么的资深心理学家。

sentences.en: You know, I was it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我就是那个负责人。

sentences.en: And that was actually really helpful for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说其实非常有帮助。

sentences.en: It didn't feel like being chucked into deep water.
sentences.zh: 这感觉并不像是被扔进深水区。

sentences.en: It felt like someone was believing in me.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是有人在信任我。

sentences.en: And so bear that in mind if you find that you're feeling a bit floundery.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你发现自己有点不知所措，请记住这一点。

sentences.en: You know, maybe it's actually a mark of someone's confidence in your ability to do that job.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能实际上标志着别人对你胜任这份工作能力的信心。

sentences.en: But if you feel like things are overwhelming, always shout out about that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你觉得事情让你不堪重负，一定要大声说出来。

sentences.en: As I said before, my, you know, I like to mark occasions and chapters with wardrobes.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，我的，你知道，我喜欢用衣着来标记人生阶段和篇章。

sentences.en: So I definitely had a qualified psychologist wardrobe and I was forever gutted that my favourite
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对有一套“合格心理学家”的行头，而且我一直很心疼我最喜欢的那件

sentences.en: I'm a qualified psychologist dress got a hole ripped in it by my NHS lanyard, which made me really sad because I loved that dress and it just wasn't repairable.
sentences.zh: “合格心理学家”连衣裙被我的国民医疗服务体系（NHS）挂绳扯破了一个洞，这让我非常难过，因为我太喜欢那件裙子了，而且它已经无法修复了。

sentences.en: You know, where the hole was, it just wasn't repairable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，洞破在那个位置，根本没法修。

sentences.en: So look after your favourite I'm a assistant psychologist or I'm a, you know, research assistant psychologist outfits because, yeah, NHS lanyards don't always like them.
sentences.zh: 所以要爱护你那些“助理心理学家”或“研究助理心理学家”的行头，因为，是的，NHS的挂绳并不总是对它们友好。

sentences.en: So as I said, I love celebrating your successes.
sentences.zh: 所以正如我所说，我喜欢庆祝你们的成功。

sentences.en: So please do come and connect with me on socials.
sentences.zh: 所以请一定要在社交媒体上与我联系。

sentences.en: Um, I, um, really easy to find on, um, certainly LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我，嗯，很容易找到，嗯，肯定是在领英上。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Tag me in or, um, you know, some other way.
sentences.zh: 艾特我，或者，嗯，用其他方式联系我。

sentences.en: Let me know about this post and I will help you celebrate because it's big and it's important.
sentences.zh: 让我知道这条动态，我会帮你庆祝，因为这很重要，意义重大。

sentences.en: And well done you.
sentences.zh: 做得好。

sentences.en: If you are listening on YouTube, um, then please subscribe and like and comment and click that little notification bell to be told when I produce more content.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在YouTube上收听，嗯，那么请订阅、点赞、评论，并点击那个小铃铛图标，以便在我发布更多内容时收到通知。

sentences.en: My kids told me to say that.
sentences.zh: 是我孩子们让我这么说的。

sentences.en: They spend a lot of their time watching YouTube.
sentences.zh: 他们花了很多时间看YouTube。

sentences.en: They love it.
sentences.zh: 他们很喜欢。

sentences.en: And I said, mummy, you've got to start asking people to click the notification bell.
sentences.zh: 我对他们说，妈妈，你得开始让大家点击通知铃铛了。

sentences.en: So there you go, kids.
sentences.zh: 所以，孩子们，你们看。

sentences.en: Mummy's done it.
sentences.zh: 妈妈做到了。

sentences.en: Um, they also want me to have merch.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们还想让我出周边产品。

sentences.en: We were shopping with my eldest, um, a few months ago and there was, um, a shopping list and on the back of it was, um, like a picture of the grief collective book.
sentences.zh: 几个月前我和大孩子去购物，嗯，当时有一张购物清单，背面有，嗯，一张《悲伤集体》书的照片。

sentences.en: And my eldest was like, mummy, quick, stick it on your back and call it merch.
sentences.zh: 我的大孩子说，妈妈，快，把它贴在你背上，叫它周边产品。

sentences.en: It really made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 这真的把我逗乐了。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, no, cause then I won't know what I need to buy.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，不行，因为那样我就不知道我需要买什么了。

sentences.en: And I'll also look very silly.
sentences.zh: 而且我看起来会很傻。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, no plans to launch any merch coming soon, guys.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，伙计们，暂时没有推出任何周边产品的计划。

sentences.en: But yeah, subscribe, like, you know, tell your friends, do all those lovely things to help me to be able to create, um, and continue to create this hopefully useful quality content
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，订阅、点赞，你知道，告诉你的朋友，做所有那些可爱的举动来帮助我，让我能够创作，嗯，并继续创作这些希望能为你提供高质量帮助的内容，

sentences.en: for you as an aspiring psychologist, whatever the stage of your journey you are at.
sentences.zh: 无论你作为一名有抱负的心理学家处于职业生涯的哪个阶段。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我期待着很快与你们再次交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, you'll guide to the inspired with Dr. Mary.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，玛丽博士将为你提供指导。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Mary Ann Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推荐链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
